notes: Fails fast (observed 5 s, log ~14 KB, no pip output), not late. BuildKit computes a cache key for each COPY by checksumming its source path in the build context up front, so the missing source fails before any RUN step executes, even though this COPY ([7/9]) comes after the pip install and the model download. In the log, the earlier steps [2/9]-[6/9] show as CACHED, the FROM step is CANCELED, and the build ends with 'ERROR: failed to build: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/apii": not found' at Dockerfile:37. Same signature as inj-022; only the path differs. The destination ./api/ is right; only the source is misspelled. In the build category (019-028), 025 and 028 are the only late failures: a RUN step can only fail when it executes, and theirs are the only failing RUN steps placed after the multi-minute pip install. 023 and 024 also fail in RUN steps, but those steps are the apt-get and pip install themselves, so they fail early.
